core.title: Wall Mounted Frosted White Glass Toothbrush Holder, Deltana 98C2013

text.description_html:
Deltana 98C2013, Classic Glass Toothbrush Tumbler

Made with the attention to quality for which Deltana is known, the 98C Series Toothbrush Holder has a classic steeped rose that is made of solid brass (available in satin nickel, polished chrome, or oil rubbed bronze finishes) and the tumbler is made of white frosted glass. A wall mounted toothbrush holder, the Deltana 98C2013 will look great in even the most sophisticated of homes.

Shop more of the Deltana 98C Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the 98C Solid Brass Classic Glass Toothbrush Tumbler With Solid Brass Steeped Rose:

  • Height: 4-1/8"
  • Width: 2-3/4"
  • Tumbler Opening Diameter: 2-7/8"
  • Overall Projection: 4-7/8"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Material: solid brass wall mount (available in satin nickel, polished chrome, or oil rubbed bronze finishes) with a white frosted glass tumbler.
  • Deltana 98C2013 Glass Toothbrush Holder Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 glass tumbler, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
